text: {"lessons":["My account is still down about 9% from Period 1, despite a small rebound; I should not assume that the recent gains signal a recovery.","Prices move randomly, so neither the decline nor the brief ups and downs provide a reliable forecast or reason to time the market.","I have traded rarely, which fits my approach; I should continue to review periodically and make measured changes only when they serve my long-term plan and risk tolerance."]}
